challenge.method: Tested whether the filename alone supplied the claimed authority, whether the release label named a license edition, and whether inclusion in the release established coverage for every component.
challenge.results: The README independently locates the notice in the library documentation and distinguishes the library from third-party contributions. It describes changes in 1.4 as software changes. The matching release texts support the root LICENSE as a controlling reference without establishing exclusive authority or package-wide coverage.

limitations: v1.4 identifies the software release. The captures establish no named license version. Active is the proposed index state.
